::: {#def-bca-acceleration}
#### Acceleration of the BCa interval

Let $\hparam_{(i)}$ be the statistic computed with observation $i$ deleted,
and let $\hparam_{(\cdot)}$ be the mean of
$\hparam_{(1)}, \ldots, \hparam_{(n)}$.
The **acceleration** is

$$\hat{a} \eqdef \frac{\sumin \paren{\hparam_{(\cdot)} - \hparam_{(i)}}^3}
{6 \paren{\sumin \paren{\hparam_{(\cdot)} - \hparam_{(i)}}^2}^{3/2}}.$$

:::
